description: Obtain an Enrollment Agent certificate, then enroll-on-behalf-of another principal against an authentication template.

telemetry.detail: Certificate Services received a certificate request (on the CA).
Certificate Services issued a certificate (on the CA). - two issuance events: the agent cert then the on-behalf-of cert.
PKINIT TGT request using the issued certificate - certificate-logon anomaly.
The enrollment-agent-then-EOBO sequence is a distinctive two-request pattern modelled by newer ITDR.

prerequisite_privilege: Enrollment on a Certificate-Request-Agent template plus an enrollable auth template
abuse_primitive: Certipy/Certify enroll agent cert, then enroll on behalf of a Domain Admin.
notes: Two certificate operations means two CA log entries, so slightly louder than ESC1/2 where CA logging is present.
